jobs.title: Web Development Intern
jobs.description:
Overview

We are looking for a Web Dev Intern who want to learn fast and build real websites and functional dashboards, not just tutorials. You help team ship sites, fix bugs, and get taste of live client work at fast-moving agency. Good place if you want turn code skill into shipped product.

The best work starts with the best team. Help us build it.

Duration (1 to 3 months).

Requirements

Strong command on HTML, CSS, JS. Bonus if know React or similar framework.
Understand responsive design, git basics.
Strong knowledge about no code platforms such as Webflow, Wordpress, Shopify , etc.
Curious mind - dig into problem.
Comfortable in fast-paced, deadline-driven setup.
Currently studying or recent graduate in CS/IT related field (or self-taught, portfolio required).

Responsibilities

Build and maintain client websites alongside senior devs.
Turn design (Figma) into working code, pixel-close.
Debug, test, fix issues across projects.
Learn agency workflow - QA, deployment.

What You Will Get

Real client work - your code will be shipped.
Mentorship from senior devs, hands-on not hand-off.
Exposure to full agency dev stack and process.
Fun and dynamic environment to learn and build something great.

If this feels like your kind of place, we'd love to meet you.

‍

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer Intern
jobs.description:
Full Stack Web Developer Intern (Paid)

Company: Zenithbyte

Location: Remote
Duration: 3 Months
For College Students Only!

Performance based stipend up-to 7500.00/-

This is a structured Career Launch Internship Program designed to help students gain practical project experience, mentorship, and industry exposure. The program includes guided learning resources, project evaluations, certificates, and performance-based opportunities.

Perks and benefits:

Performance based stipend up-to 7500.00/-

Certificate of Internship
Letter of Recommendation (based on performance)
Swags and goodies
Potential full-time role based on performance

Role Overview:

Work on live projects involving both front-end and back-end development. Gain hands-on experience with modern web technologies and build strong technical skills.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain responsive websites
Build dynamic web applications
Test, debug, and optimize applications
Collaborate with designers and developers

Eligibility:

Students or recent graduates in Computer Science, IT, or related fields with knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity with React, Angular, or Node.js is preferred.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Internship

Employment type

Internship

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting, IT System Training and Support, and E-Learning Providers
